timeline.description: The Sangam age is broadly divided into three phases based on poetic output and archaeological evidence.

mnemonics.title: Mnemonics & Tricks to Remember
mnemonics.description: Simplify the complex classification of the Sangam landscape.

items.title: K.M.P.M.N
items.decryption: Remember the 5 'Thinai' (Eco-zones) landscape divisions: Mountain, Forest, Desert, Agricultural, Coastal.

traps.title: UPSC Common Exam Traps
items: Confusing 'Sangam Literature' with 'Vedic Literature'. Remember, Sangam is secular, not religious.
Assuming the Sangam period followed the Vedic timeline directly in South India; these cultures were largely contemporaneous.
Thinking that the 'Sangams' were only physical academies; they were also literary conventions.

deepDive.description: Master the key concepts and dimensions of this topic.

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Geography

  • Five Eco-zones (Tinai).
  • Major Capitals: Madurai, Uraiyur, Vanji.

Society

  • Caste was not rigid.
  • Role of Women (Avvaiyar).
  • Hero-stones (Virakal).

The Tinai System (Mindmap Overview)

  • Kurinji: Hilly terrain (Murugan/Hunting).
  • Mullai: Pastoral/Forest (Mayon/Herding).
  • Marutam: Agricultural (Indra/Ploughing).
  • Neithal: Coastal (Varunan/Fishing).
  • Palai: Arid/Desert (Korravai/Robbery).
